slot.brief: Give a complex (3d metal with ligands of mixed field strength); ask for the d-orbital configuration, spin state and unpaired electron count

stem: For octahedral $[\text{Co}(\text{NH}_3)_4\text{Cl}_2]^+$, identify its $d$-orbital configuration, spin state and number of unpaired electrons.

verdicts.working: Co has oxidation state +3: x−2=+1, so it is d⁶. Octahedral Co(III) here is low-spin, with t₂g⁶e_g⁰ and 0 unpaired electrons.

working:
Co oxidation state: $x-2=+1$, so $x=+3$; $\text{Co}^{3+}$ is $d^6$.
Octahedral Co(III) with this ligand set: low-spin $t_{2g}^{6}e_g^{0}$.
All six electrons are paired; unpaired electrons $=0$.

solution: For $[\text{Co}(\text{NH}_3)_4\text{Cl}_2]^+$, let the oxidation state of Co be $x$: $x-2=+1$, so $x=+3$ and Co$^{3+}$ is $d^6$. In the octahedral low-spin configuration, $$t_{2g}^{6}e_g^{0},$$ all six electrons are paired, giving $0$ unpaired electrons.
